body.text: **Console Home** displays **widgets** with important information about this portfolio.
**Add**, **remove**, **rearrange**, and **resize** widgets to customize your Console Home dashboard. Changes you make are saved in this browser and do not affect other visitors.
**Add widgets** by choosing the **+Add widgets** button and the **drag indicator** (six vertical dots) on the widget title bar to drag it to your Console Home dashboard.
**Remove widgets** by choosing the **ellipsis** (three vertical dots) at the top-right corner.
**Rearrange widgets** by choosing the **drag indicator** (six vertical dots) on the title bar and dragging it to a new location.
**Resize widgets** by choosing the **resize icon** at the bottom-right corner.
For more information, see [Working with widgets](https://github.com/AB527/aws-console-portfolio).

links.label: Getting started with the AB Management Console

body.text: **Jump in where you left off** and navigate to the services and projects you most recently worked with.
To view all services, choose [View all services](/console/services) at the bottom of the widget.
Get to know **Atharva Bedekar**: his background, values, and what drives his passion for engineering and technology.
Track Atharva's open-source activity on **GitHub** at a glance: **public repositories**, **recent contributions**, and **followers**.
Explore **certifications**, **milestones**, and **recognitions** that mark key moments in Atharva's engineering journey.
Browse solutions and projects built across **cloud infrastructure**, **full-stack development**, and **AI/ML** domains.
Stay up to date with Atharva's latest **milestones**, **recognitions**, and **project launches**.
Read Atharva's recent write-ups and articles on **DevOps**, **security**, and **cloud engineering**.
**Projects** are the systems and code Atharva has built and shipped. Each row is one project, with its type, state, the users it served and the period it ran.
**Select a project** to open its summary, or choose **Connect** to open the live project.
The summary shows a project's **type**, **tech stack**, **state**, **period**, **scale** and **link**, followed by a description and its tags.
**Buckets** are containers for the documents stored in Documents. Each bucket groups one kind of document, such as resumes, certifications or letters.
Choose a **bucket name** to see the objects inside it.
A bucket holds **objects**, and each object is **one document**.
**Select an object** to copy its **URI**. **Open** and **Download** are available when the file has been added to the site.
An **object** is a single document. The overview lists its **size**, **type**, **last modified date** and identifiers.
**Open** and **Download** are available when the file has been added to the site.
A **skill group** is a collection of related skills. Roles in the experience history draw on one or more skill groups.
Choose a **group name** to see its skills and the roles that used them.
Every individual **skill**, the **group** it belongs to, and the **proficiency level**.
**Roles** held, the **organization**, and the **skill groups** each role used. **Choose a role** to see its summary and permissions.
A **Connect** is the network that holds every way to get in touch. It contains **subnets**, and each subnet routes to **contact links**.
Details lists the Connect's **ID**, **state**, **address range** and **owner**, along with the number of subnets it holds.
The **resource map** shows how the **Connect**, its **subnets** and their **route tables** relate.
**Choose a route table** to see where it leads. Turn on **Show all details** to see names and address ranges.
A **subnet** groups one kind of contact route. **Select a subnet** to see its details and the route table it uses.
A **route table** lists the routes of a subnet. The **target** of each route is a real link you can open.
**Experience** records the work history as **trails** and **events**. The dashboard shows every trail and the most recent role changes.
Each **trail** is one role in the work history. A trail that is still **logging** is a **current role**.
Choose a **trail name** to open that role.
Every role **started** and **ended**, newest first. On the full Event history page you can **filter** by an attribute and **sort** the columns.
A **project type** groups projects of the same kind and scale. Each row shows the tech stack, the users served and the hours spent across its projects.
**Select a type** to see its details and the projects that belong to it.
Describe what you are looking for, such as scale or whether the work is open source, and the **finder** suggests the **project types** that match.
